text:
alexa_cs: FYI - AcmeHealth (acct 8902) invoice #7892 autopay retried 3x and all card attempts declined. Customer is mid-onboarding, needs immediate settlement to avoid blocking production. Suggest manual collect today + wire option if they want. Anyone blocking?

sam_fin: can you paste the decline codes and last4? also was it AVS/name mismatch or issuer auth?

alexa_cs: last4 4242, declines: `insufficient_funds`, `do_not_honor`, `do_not_honor`. Attempts at 2026-03-22T09:14Z, 09:18Z, 09:43Z. No AVS mismatch reported from gateway.

billing-bot: Payment attempt report: invoice=7892 customer=AcmeHealth attempts=3 status=failed gateway=Stripe region=us-west-2

mike_sales: they're on our 30-day onboarding trial, high-value. Sales asks we prioritize; if we trigger manual collect, we'll need explicit consent and note this may require a card capture or wire. :pray:

jin_finance: ok we can do manual collect once CS confirms written consent and PO# (if available). Also need approval for waiving late fee. cc @legal-bot for any contract constraints.

alexa_cs: confirmed will get written consent now. PO# is PO-23344 (customer provided). sending copy of customer's reply here in a sec.

alexa_cs: Customer msg: "We had an issue with our corporate card auth window. Please send wire instructions and we'll remit today. If possible, please attempt one more card auth after 30m."

sam_fin: prefer wire to avoid repeat declines. please create manual invoice with wire instructions and set payment_method=wire so system doesn't auto-retry card.

jin_finance: approved to create manual invoice and set payment_method=wire for settlement. waive late fee for this one-off. get customer confirmation on beneficiary name and reference. once we have proof of wire, mark invoice paid.

alexa_cs: copying wire template below and pinging customer for beneficiary + reference.

alexa_cs: ```Wire instructions (Redwood Inference - placeholder)
Bank: Example Bank PLC
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: XXXX-XXXX (provide on request)
IBAN: [provide on request]
SWIFT: EXAMPUS33
Reference: Invoice 7892 / AcmeHealth PO-23344
Note: customer must include exact reference or payment may be delayed.```

mike_sales: please also send a short paylink as fallback (one-click card capture) but disable auto-retries. wording: "If you'd prefer to pay by card we can send a secure one-time pay link; otherwise wire instructions attached."

alexa_cs: will send both. also, timeline: customer aims to wire by EOD PST. I'll mark stages in Salesforce and attach correspondence.

sam_fin: after wire clears, please attach proof (SWIFT copy) in billing ticket. then we run reconciliation and close invoice.

legal-bot: no contractual blocker flagged for manual collect or wire settlement. ensure we store consent email in billing record.

jin_finance: thanks all. Action items: alexa_cs to get consent + beneficiary confirmation (eta 2h), sam_fin to create manual invoice with wire flag, mike_sales to prepare fallback paylink copy. escalate to leadership if not settled by EOD PST. :alarm_clock:

alexa_cs: on it, will update thread when customer replies.

billing-bot: Ticket #BILL-4421 created for manual-collect / wire settlement for invoice 7892.
